findings.highlight: we need to start finalizing everything
findings.evidenceJa: 実はそろそろ出ないといけない時間
findings.explanation: Kazusa says it is nearly time for them to leave, despite still having time before the performance. The English instead says it is time to finalize everything, replacing an immediate physical departure with an unspecified production task.
findings.japanese:
「本番まではまだ少し余裕あるけど、
実はそろそろ出ないといけない時間」
findings.todokanai: "We still have some time before the live performance, but it's getting to the point where we need to start finalizing everything."

findings.highlight: applying to our department formally next year
findings.evidenceJa: 来年ウチ受けるって言ってる以上
findings.explanation: Mari says Haruki intends to apply to their company next year, so she is training him now. The English changes the target to their department, materially altering his employment plan and her reason for mentoring him.
findings.japanese:
「来年ウチ受けるって言ってる以上、
今のうちから鍛えておかないと」
findings.todokanai: "He said he'd be applying to our department formally next year, so I'm using this as an opportunity to prepare him."

findings.evidenceJa: 諏訪までダビングしろとか言ってきたし
findings.explanation: Suwa asked for a duplicate or dub copy of the festival recording. The English says he asked to record voices over it, inventing a creative voice-dubbing task rather than copying the video.
findings.japanese:
「例の『開桜グラフ』が出てからお前らで５組目だよ。
諏訪までダビングしろとか言ってきたし」
findings.todokanai: "You're already the fifth bunch to come to me after that Kaiou Graph article. Suwa even told me to dub some voices over it."

findings.highlight: looking at others from a distance as if he were a complete stranger
findings.evidenceJa: 他人事みたいに自分を遠くから見てて
findings.explanation: Koharu says Haruki steps back and watches himself from afar as though his own life were someone else's affair. The English instead has him watch other people from a distance, deleting the self-alienation at the center of her diagnosis.
findings.japanese:
「一歩退いて、他人事みたいに自分を遠くから見てて、
人の心が近づくのを極端に恐れる、冷血動物だよ」
findings.todokanai: "He's always removed, looking at others from a distance as if he were a complete stranger, absolutely terrified of getting close… A cold-blooded animal…"

findings.highlight: Is the person I saw in the music room back then…
findings.evidenceJa: あの時の、音楽室の、あいつだよ
findings.explanation: Koharu concludes that the person on the recording is the same Haruki she saw in the music room. The English leaves an unfinished question and never states the recognition that reconciles his apparently different selves.
findings.japanese: 「あの時の、音楽室の、あいつだよ…」
findings.todokanai: "Is the person I saw in the music room back then…"

findings.explanation: The manuscript had not advanced a line for more than a full day before being completed in one hour. “Almost the whole day” reverses the boundary and weakens the deliberate more-than-a-day versus one-hour contrast.
findings.japanese:
丸一日以上、机の前で唸っても、
一行も進まなかった原稿が、
たったの一時間で仕上がってしまった。
findings.todokanai: I finally finished the manuscript that had me groaning in front of my desk because of how I've been incapable of progressing with it for almost the whole day, and it took me only an hour.

findings.highlight: I remembered everythingーhow she never opened her heart to anyone, her status as a prodigy of the music program, how she struggled with the regular curriculum, how she was usually irritable but mellowed out eventually, and how she was frank, yet not so honest after all…
findings.evidenceJa:
誰にも心を開かなかった、音楽科の天才にして、
普通科の落ちこぼれが、怒ったり、黄昏れたり、
素直になったり、素直じゃなかったり…
findings.explanation: The source lists Kazusa getting angry, brooding, becoming honest, and being dishonest; the English turns part of that sequence into a stable irritable personality that later mellowed.
findings.japanese:
誰にも心を開かなかった、音楽科の天才にして、
普通科の落ちこぼれが、怒ったり、黄昏れたり、
素直になったり、素直じゃなかったり…
findings.todokanai: I remembered everythingーhow she never opened her heart to anyone, her status as a prodigy of the music program, how she struggled with the regular curriculum, how she was usually irritable but mellowed out eventually, and how she was frank, yet not so honest after all…

findings.highlight: I have no intention of worrying
findings.evidenceJa: 考えるのも億劫になってきた
findings.explanation: Haruki has become too exhausted even to think about his guilt and satisfaction. The English makes this a deliberate refusal or lack of intention to worry, replacing depletion with volitional avoidance.
findings.japanese:
けどもう、そんな罪悪感も満足感も、
考えるのも億劫になってきた。
findings.todokanai: Even so, I have no intention of worrying about either my guilt or my satisfaction.
